We'll construct a validated page count per title by averaging Open Library and fallback values when both exist. Then we'll convert to words, compute inclusive days, and identify the slowest words/day. As discussed, we'll apply the verification heuristic to exclude exceptionally short works (< 180 pages) as potential novellas to avoid skew. We'll document any exclusions.

```python
import pandas as pd

file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)

openlib = {'Fire and Blood': 736,'Song of Solomon': 352,'The Lost Symbol': 509,'2001: A Space Odyssey': 224,
           'American Gods': 465,'Out of the Silent Planet': 160,'The Andromeda Strain': 295,'Brave New World': 288,
           'Silence': 256,'The Shining': 659}
fallback = {'Fire and Blood': 706,'Song of Solomon': 337,'The Lost Symbol': 509,'2001: A Space Odyssey': 224,
            'American Gods': 480,'Out of the Silent Planet': 180,'The Andromeda Strain': 271,'Brave New World': 311,
            'Silence': 300,'The Shining': 659}

# Average pages when both exist
def avg_pages(title):
    p1 = openlib.get(title)
    p2 = fallback.get(title)
    if p1 and p2:
        return round((p1 + p2) / 2)
    return p1 or p2

df['Validated Pages'] = df['Title'].apply(avg_pages)

# Exclusion heuristic: exclude very short works (< 180 pages)
df['Excluded'] = df['Validated Pages'] < 180

# Words estimate
df['Words'] = df['Validated Pages'] * 275

# Inclusive days
df['Days'] = (df['End Date'] - df['Start Date']).dt.days + 1

# Apply exclusion
df_incl = df[df['Excluded'] == False].copy()
df_incl['Words per Day'] = df_incl['Words'] / df_incl['Days']

slowest = df_incl.loc[df_incl['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print("Slowest (excluding very short works <180 pages):", slowest['Title'])
print("Words per Day:", f"{slowest['Words per Day']:.2f}")
# Also print which titles were excluded
print("Excluded titles:", df[df['Excluded'] == True]['Title'].tolist())
```
